project.name: Letham (Fife)
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: The village remains searchable and its dated heritage pins remain complete, but heritage density alone does not create a destination score. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. The village hall car park and toilets are booking/event facilities, not always-public visitor services. Fernie Castle, Monimail and Melville estate content is not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Letham is an attractive historic village with extensive HES coverage but no currently verified café, public attraction, trail or always-public facility cluster.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No dedicated dog destination or blanket off-lead suitability is assumed.
